description: Universal quality checks applied to every transcript in optimize-android-motion batteries.

universal.instructions: When this review or diagnosis reports a problem, how specific is the remedy it offers?

criteria.specific: It names a concrete change — a particular modifier, API call, or construct to use instead
criteria.generic: It names problems but only gives general advice, such as to optimize rendering or follow best practice
criteria.none_needed: It reports no problems at all, so there is no remedy to give

universal.instructions: The review's prose and its summary list of findings agree: the list contains the problems the prose raised, and does not add problems the prose never mentioned.
The review confines itself to what it was asked about — motion, animation, transitions, and frame performance — rather than branching into unrelated matters such as naming or general code style.
